<a id="symbol-asciiSlice"></a>
## `asciiSlice` · [source](ascii.aug#L3)

Internal bounded byte slice; retain a single ConversionError parsing boundary. It takes `input` as `Bytes` and `start` and `end` as integers. It tries to return `text` on `input.slice` with `start` and `end`. If this work raises `IndexError`, it raises a `ConversionError`. [source](ascii.aug#L4-L7)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
asciiSlice(Bytes input, int start, int end) returns string unless ConversionError
```

It takes `input` as `Bytes` and `start` and `end` as integers. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-asciiAt"></a>
## `asciiAt` · [source](ascii.aug#L10)

Internal single-byte read. Multibyte UTF-8 fragments are rejected. It takes `input` as `Bytes` and `index` as an integer. It returns [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input`, `start` from `index`, and `end` from `index` plus `1`. [source](ascii.aug#L11)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
asciiAt(Bytes input, int index) returns string unless ConversionError
```

It takes `input` as `Bytes` and `index` as an integer. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-asciiLetter"></a>
## `asciiLetter` · [source](ascii.aug#L14)

Internal ASCII letter classification. It takes `character` as a string. It returns (`character.compare` with `other` `"A"` is at least `0` and `character.compare` with `other` `"Z"` is at most `0`) or (`character.compare` with `other` `"a"` is at least `0` and `character.compare` with `other` `"z"` is at most `0`). [source](ascii.aug#L15-L18)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
asciiLetter(string character) returns bool
```

It takes `character` as a string.

</details>

<a id="symbol-asciiLower"></a>
## `asciiLower` · [source](ascii.aug#L21)

Internal case folding for already validated ASCII components only. It takes `text` as a string.

It sets `result` to `text`. It sets `upper` to the UTF-8 bytes of `"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"`. It sets `lower` to the UTF-8 bytes of `"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"`. It sets `index` to `0`. [source](ascii.aug#L22-L25)

While `index` is less than `26`, it sets `result` to `result.replace` with `search` from [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `upper` and `index` and `replacement` from [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `lower` and `index`; then it increases `index` by `1`. After the loop, it returns `result`. [source](ascii.aug#L26-L29)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
asciiLower(string text) returns string unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
